newsitem.title: USA: Allegiant to acquire Reliance Financial.
newsitem.headline: Allegiant to acquire Reliance Financial.

text.p: Allegiant Bancorp Inc and Reliance Financial Inc said Friday they had entered into a definitive agreement for Allegiant to acquire Reliance.
Allegiant will exchange 1.6741 Allegiant shares for each Reliance share, they said.
The acquisition is expected to be completed around September 30 and is subject to regulatory and shareholder approval, they said.

After the merger, the companies said Reliance Federal Savings and Loan Association of St. Louis County, Reliance's wholly owned subsidiary, will continue to operate as a separate subsidiary with its current management and staff.
As of December 31, Reliance had $31.7 million in total assets.
Allegiant, which operates six locations in St. Louis and two in northeastern Missouri, had $377.6 million in assets as of December 31.
